featured_reviews.review_text: Fun Republic Mall has been a part of my life since 2015, and watching it change over the years feels deeply personal to me. Back then, the mall had a completely different vibe, yet it always felt lively and comforting. Over the years, I saw places come and go, brands change, and the entire atmosphere slowly evolve. From Dohi to Si Noonas, from Slingshot to Queen’s Margarita, I witnessed every transformation closely. Each place carried its own memories, energy, and crowd, making the mall feel like a timeline of my growing years. Even though many things have changed, Fun Republic still feels connected to my past. Every visit reminds me of old friendships, unforgettable conversations, and carefree moments that can never truly be recreated anywhere else. It will always remain one of the most nostalgic places in my life. No matter how modern it becomes, the memories attached to it will always feel timeless to me

Infiniti Mall

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Accessibility
PVR Citi Mall is conveniently situated inside Citi Mall on Andheri Link Road, near Bhaktivedanta Swami Mission School in Oshiwara, Andheri West. It's approximately 0.7 km from D.N. Nagar metro station and about 3 km from Andheri railway station—making it easily accessible by both metro and train .

Ambience & Facilities
This multiplex stands out for its modern, well-maintained interiors and ambient decor. Regular amenities include recliner seating, digital ticketing, wheelchair access, air conditioning, food & beverage counters, and parking . According to aggregated data, it holds a solid average rating of 4.2 out of 5, reflecting consistently positive visitor experiences .

Viewing Experience
The picture and sound quality are frequently praised. A reviewer exclaimed: “Amazing sound quality, large screens and yes the food options are so good that you can actually have dinner while watching a movie there!” . Others highlight comfortable seating with decent legroom, crisp visuals, and reliable acoustics—a true immersive cinematic experience .

Value & Pricing
While not the cheapest option, the multiplex strikes a commendable balance between quality and cost. “Affordable rates of movie tickets” assures one user, and another noted it’s cheaper compared to nearby PVR outlets . However, concession stand prices are notably high, which is common in most multiplexes .

Room for Improvement
There are occasional complaints about minor inconveniences: some reports mention cramped seating in certain areas, delayed show starts by 10–15 minutes, and pricing concerns for snacks . Cleanliness and general upkeep are good but have room to be elevated to match the premium ambience.

---

Summary Table

Feature	Rating & Highlights

Overall Rating	4.2 / 5
Location	Very accessible via metro and train
Ambience & Comfort	Modern interiors, comfortable seating, AC
Viewing Quality	Excellent sound & visuals, immersive experience
Value	Reasonably priced tickets; snacks on the higher side
Concerns	Occasional delays, snack pricing, sparse lapses in seating space

---

Final Verdict:
PVR Citi Mall in Andheri West offers a high-quality cinema experience with modern amenities, accessible location, and immersive audiovisuals. Minor points regarding concessions pricing and occasional delays don’t significantly detract from its overall appeal. For movie lovers seeking comfort and convenience without breaking the bank, this is a reliable choice—earning a well-deserved 4.2 out of 5 stars.

featured_reviews.name: Srijith Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Citi Mall, Andheri (W), Mumbai to watch the Malayalam movie “Drishyam 3”, and it was a really nice cinema experience.

Citi Mall is one of the older buildings in Andheri West, but what I liked is that it still maintains its class and charm. Even though the building has been there for many years, the cinema experience inside still feels comfortable, organised, and enjoyable. It has that old Mumbai theatre feeling, but with modern facilities added properly.

The location is also a big advantage. Being in the centre of Andheri West, on Link Road, it is easy to access and convenient for movie lovers from nearby areas. For someone coming to watch a movie after work, with family, or with friends, the location works very well.

The seating was comfortable, and the premium chairs made the movie experience even better. The recliner-style seating and overall comfort helped us enjoy the movie without any discomfort. The screen, sound, air conditioning, and theatre atmosphere were all good, and it felt like PVR has maintained the place well.

The food and beverage options also added to the experience. Having snacks and food available inside the cinema makes it easy to enjoy the movie fully. The food counters, movie snacks, and overall service were convenient and well managed. The adjustable food trays in the seating area are also very useful, especially when you want to enjoy your snacks comfortably during the movie.

What I appreciated most is that PVR Citi Mall has kept its standard despite being in an older mall. The place still offers good facilities like comfortable seating, premium chairs, food and beverages, parking, mobile ticketing, wheelchair-friendly access, air conditioning, and a proper multiplex experience.

Watching a Malayalam movie like Drishyam 3 there felt special. The crowd, the theatre feel, the comfort, and the overall setup made it a memorable movie outing.

Overall, PVR Citi Mall, Andheri (W) is a good cinema option in Mumbai for anyone looking for a comfortable movie experience in a very convenient location. It carries the charm of an old building but still gives the facilities and comfort expected from a modern PVR cinema. Definitely a nice place to watch movies with family, friends, or even alone.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently watched a movie at PVR Citimall Theatre, and while the experience had its positives, there were also a few drawbacks. The seating was decent but not very comfortable; the seats felt a bit stiff, which made it tough to stay relaxed throughout the film. For a theatre experience, I expected a higher level of comfort.

One major downside was the lengthy advertisements. Although the movie was scheduled for 10:30 pm, it didn’t actually start until 10:54 pm because of nearly half an hour of ads. It’s understandable to have a few commercials, but this was excessive and made the wait for the actual movie feel frustrating. When people choose a specific showtime, it’s disappointing to sit through so many ads before the main feature even begins.

On a positive note, the theatre does offer a few conveniences. The food options were available and well-maintained, and washrooms were easily accessible and clean. They also provided drinking water facilities, which was a nice touch. However, despite these conveniences, the excessive ads and less-than-comfortable seats would make me think twice before choosing this theatre again for a movie night. A few adjustments could really improve the experience for patrons.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Cinépolis is one of the most popular multiplex chains in Mumbai, known for its sleek, modern design and high-end cinematic technology. Whether you are visiting the one in Andheri, Thane, or Navi Mumbai, the vibe is consistently premium. It’s a top-tier choice for movie-goers who prioritize comfort, crystal-clear visuals, and a great atmosphere for a day out with friends or family.
Pros:
Superior Comfort: The seating is well-spaced with excellent legroom. If you opt for the VIP or IMAX screens, the leather recliners are incredibly cozy.
Cutting-Edge Tech: They use advanced laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound systems, making the action feel very immersive.
Variety of Formats: Depending on the location, you can choose from 4DX (moving seats/effects), IMAX, or their luxury "Coffee Tree" service.
Cleanliness: The lobbies and washrooms are generally well-maintained and have a "high-class" feel.
Cons:
Expensive Concessions: Like most premium malls, the popcorn and sodas are quite pricey—sometimes costing more than the movie ticket itself!
Peak Hour Crowds: During big blockbuster releases or weekends, the lobby can get very crowded, leading to long queues at the security check and food counters.
Parking Fees: Since most Cinépolis theaters are inside major malls, you’ll have to pay the standard (and sometimes steep) mall parking rates.

From watching exciting first day first shows with friends to spending peaceful evenings alone with popcorn and a good film, this place has silently witnessed many phases of my life. The atmosphere, the familiar ticket counters, the glowing posters, and even the smell of freshly made popcorn instantly bring back old emotions whenever I walk inside. No matter how much the city changes, Cinepolis Andheri still feels comfortingly familiar to me. Some places are special because of their beauty, while others become special because of the memories created there. For me, this theatre represents laughter, friendships, excitement, and countless unforgettable moments. Every corner reminds me of a different chapter of my journey. Even today, whenever I visit Cinepolis Andheri, I feel the same happiness and nostalgia that I felt years ago, making it a truly irreplaceable place in my heart. No matter how busy life becomes, returning there always feels like revisiting a comforting piece of my past that still warmly welcomes me home again

Movie Max Goregaon - Honest Review

Visited Movie Max Goregaon with friends to watch Pushpa 2, but the experience was disappointing for several reasons:

1. Parking Charges: The two-wheeler parking fee is ₹50, which is very high for a single-screen theater. Even premium theaters like PVR or INOX charge less.

2. Toilet Facilities: The number of toilets was very limited, leading to long queues. The toilets were also very small, which was inconvenient for the crowd.

3. Drinking Water: There was no drinking water facility available, which was surprising and inconvenient for the audience.

4. Sound Quality: The sound system was not loud enough, and I missed many dialogues during the movie. This was a major letdown.

Overall, the theater didn’t meet basic expectations for comfort or amenities. I might not visit again unless these issues are addressed. Would recommend exploring better theaters in the area for a more enjoyable movie experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Fantastic Studio and a great place to work with all the post production facilities available under one roof and a wonderful team,  professional technicians and cordial staff.
As a filmmaker, finding a post-production studio that respects your creative voice while pushing technical boundaries is rare. Sunmax Cinemas Studio does exactly that. Their workflow is highly efficient, their Editing, Sound Recording and DI teams are incredibly sharp, and the final master looked stunning on the big screen. They have a deep understanding of cinematic storytelling. Huge thanks to the team for their dedication and stellar work.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Anuradha Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sunmax Studio is truly a one-stop destination for picture post and video post production. From the very beginning of your shoot till the final delivery, they stand by you with complete technical support and professionalism. You can consult them even before your shoot begins, do technical checks with your first day’s footage, and then work with complete peace of mind knowing your project is in capable hands.

The director and owner of the studio is exceptionally knowledgeable, technically sound, and remarkably quick in finding solutions. She is one of those rare professionals who understands every aspect of post-production with great clarity and patience. Her warm, cooperative nature and commitment towards every project make you want to return again and again for their services.

The studio has highly qualified technicians, and a special mention for Ankit, who handles DI and colour correction with great sincerity and skill. I still remember one particular night when I was struggling to finish a film within a deadline. Despite not being well himself and already working through nights on other deliverables, he extended every possible help and ensured I could complete my work on time. Such dedication and professionalism are not easy to find.

Sunmax Studio is clean, comfortable, and very conveniently located. They operate day and night, which becomes a huge support during tight schedules and deadlines. They even have a small kitchen serving tea and coffee, along with a pleasant space to sit and eat, making long working hours much easier and comfortable.

They have everything required to complete your picture post or video post work with great satisfaction and technical finesse. I would especially like to thank Nidhi for being so kind, supportive, and helpful throughout my post-production journey and for extending help in every possible way to complete the film smoothly.

I would highly recommend Sunmax Studio not only for picture post and DI work, but also for VFX services. A wonderful team, backed by genuine commitment and technical excellence.

I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.

featured_reviews.name: Mr.Khachack
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Rajhansh Cinema in Ghatkopar. The movie ticket was ₹300, which is fine, but the theatre quality honestly didn’t match the price. The projector seemed dull and outdated, which really affects the viewing experience.
I also bought food from the counter — ₹200 for fries that were even smaller than a McDonald's small fries, and a pizza for ₹250 that was quite small and average in taste. Overall, the food felt overpriced for the quantity and quality provided.
I hope they improve the theatre experience and food value, especially considering the prices they charge.
